title: Executive Overview
note: Computed by checks_dashboards_demo.py from the frozen .psv rows, with the same definitions truths.out uses. Each value carries the SQL it came from; Phase B2 holds every widget to these numbers.

kpis.label: Revenue
kpis.sql: SELECT round(sum(o.total_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND year(o.order_ts) = 2026

kpis.label: Orders
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND year(o.order_ts) = 2026

kpis.label: New customers
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.customers WHERE year(signup_date) = 2026

kpis.label: DSO, days
kpis.sql: SELECT 365.0 * (SELECT sum(amount + tax_amount) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE issue_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' AND (last_paid_date IS NULL OR last_paid_date > DATE '2026-09-30')) / (SELECT sum(amount + tax_amount) FROM dash_demo.invoices WHERE issue_date > DATE '2026-09-30' - INTERVAL 365 DAY AND issue_date <= DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: On-time delivery %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN o.delivered_ts::DATE <= o.promised_date THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.delivered_ts IS NOT NULL AND year(o.delivered_ts) = 2026

kpis.label: Headcount
kpis.sql: SELECT count(*) FROM dash_demo.employees WHERE hire_date <= DATE '2026-09-30' AND (termination_date IS NULL OR termination_date > DATE '2026-09-30')

kpis.label: Gross margin %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * sum(l.line_amount - l.line_cost) / sum(l.line_amount), 2) FROM dash_demo.order_lines l JOIN dash_demo.orders o USING (order_id) WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND year(o.order_ts) = 2026

kpis.label: SLA met %
kpis.sql: SELECT round(100.0 * count(CASE WHEN NOT sla_breached THEN 1 END) / count(*), 2) FROM dash_demo.support_tickets WHERE year(opened_ts) = 2026

density.rule: a monthly bar or line of events, company totals
density.sql: SELECT min(n) FROM (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM dash_demo.orders o WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled' AND year(o.order_ts) = 2026 GROUP BY date_trunc('month', o.order_ts))
